standouts.head: Buyers stepping in earlier
standouts.text: A higher low in price (Nov 23) against a lower low in momentum (4 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
standouts.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

standouts.head: Accumulation
standouts.text: In five weeks it had 4 up days and 0 down days on volume above both the day before and its average.
standouts.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 47% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

material.head: SPY: below its 200-day
material.text: SPY, the fund it follows, is below its 200-day average.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the Jul 30 low, the 50-week average and the most-traded price of six months, where 8 levels (3 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Wave 4 turning up from its zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Oct 6 to Nov 9 (+24%; wave 3 is 2.4 times wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−3.4% to −5.4%), on lighter volume, with the Jun 11 low and the 50% retracement of the Aug 6–Oct 6 drop in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−9.7%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

material.head: Next support −1.6% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −1.6% below (0.6 ATR), where 10 levels (3 kinds) meet: the Jun 11 low, the 200-day average and the 61.8% retracement of the Aug 6–Oct 6 drop.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
